patch_description:
The current program's added rx_global layer increased parameters to 56 and worsened generalization (gap 0.04 vs 0.02). The prior best programs achieved 0.91 combined score with exactly 50 parameters using only two-parameter phase schedules (rz_pre_a, rz_pre_b).

This edit:
1. Removes the 8-qubit rx_global layer entirely (saves 8 gate instances, reduces parameter bloat)
2. Merges post-entanglement RZ rotations to reuse rz_pre_a/rz_pre_b instead of rz_post_a/rz_post_b (reduces unique parameters from 10 to 8 for phase layers)
3. Returns to the proven 50-parameter configuration while keeping the efficient linear chain entanglement

This should recover the 0.91 combined score by reducing overfitting and improving parameter efficiency, while maintaining the validated entanglement structure.
